people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
translations.bsb: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.
translations.kjv: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
translations.asv: because for the work of Christ he came nigh unto death, hazarding his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
